description: Aircraft displayed on plinths across the former Fürstenfeldbruck air base, together with the private military-history collection of the Traditionsgemeinschaft Fursty in the Captain Richard Higgins building. The Bund offered the plinth aircraft to the town of Fürstenfeldbruck in 2023 and their long-term home is unsettled. No individual serials are published for these airframes; they need reading on site.
